page.title: Settings
page.purpose: Own every preference this scenario needs — appearance, language, accessibility, notification reach, and economy defaults — in one place for both audiences.

priorities.statement: A holder sees only the preferences that apply to them.
priorities.notes: The settings page is shared, but the minter's economy defaults are not a holder's business.

priorities.statement: Accessibility preferences are first-class, not buried under appearance.
priorities.notes: The holder view may be used by a child; text scale and reduced motion are primary controls here.

priorities.statement: Locale switching is owned here, per the shell contract.
